name: betraying-blade-on-attack-decline-no-counter
notes: Betraying Blade (qwxvzfkpaj, WIND ATTACK, reserve 2, power 2): "On Attack: You may pay (2). If you do, put a preparation counter on your champion." Player 1 ends turn 1 (first-player attack lock), then player 2 plays Betraying Blade from hand for real (two reserve payments), picks player 1's champion as the target, and the On Attack trigger (onAttackAbilities['qwxvzfkpaj:0'] -> customDQHandlers['qwxvzfkpaj:0:OnAttack-1']) asks player 2 whether to pay (2); player 2 holds 7+ cards. Player 2's champion is the Material-section Spirit of Wind, so WIND needs no lineage patch. Answering NO pays nothing and puts no preparation counter on the champion.

rulesClauses: On Attack: You may pay (2). (If you do not, nothing is paid and no preparation counter is put on your champion.)
